name: Rakka Ten
source:
An urban legend once said that if you make eye contact with those who commit suicide by jumping off a building, their spirit will forever watch you.

This game focuses on protagonist Ishida Kazuma, an honor student known for his high self-esteem and arrogance. 

One day, when he spends his time at school as usual, he happens to see a figure on the roof of the old school building. Then he suddenly hears someone call his name. When he turns around, someone fell off the roof...

The man who jumped off the building was Ishida's best friend, Kawamura Naoto.
translation:
有一则都市传说：如果与跳楼自杀的人对上目光，对方的亡魂就会永远注视着你。

本作的主人公是伊希达·卡祖马，一名自尊心极强、傲慢自负的优等生。

某天，他像往常一样待在学校，偶然看到旧校舍楼顶有个人影。随后，他突然听见有人叫自己的名字。就在他转过身时，有人从楼顶坠落了…

跳楼的人，是伊希达最好的朋友卡瓦穆拉·纳奥托。
